concepts.name: NDA effective date
justifications: The agreement expressly sets 1 February 2027 as the Effective Date; signing occurred earlier and effectiveness was deferred.

concepts.name: NDA permitted purpose
predicted: evaluating a possible minority investment by the recipient in the discloser's marine sensor business under project glassfinch.
gold: evaluating a possible minority investment by the recipient in the discloser's marine sensor business under project glassfinch.
values: Evaluating a possible minority investment by the Recipient in the Discloser's marine sensor business under Project Glassfinch.
justifications: The agreement identifies this as the sole Permitted Purpose and specifies the transaction type, business, and project name.

concepts.name: NDA disclosure window end
justifications: The executed termination notice closes the disclosure window effective 30 November 2027, earlier than its ordinary end date.

concepts.name: NDA contractual forum
justifications: The parties designate the courts of Oslo as their contractual forum.

concepts.name: NDA signatory entities
justifications: FjordSignal AS is identified as a signatory party registered in Norway and designated as the Discloser.
Talus Ventures AB is identified as a signatory party registered in Sweden and designated as the Recipient.

concepts.name: Protected assets at the April snapshot
justifications: LUMEN’s non-public combination remains protected despite its public components; SHORE’s prior-possession evidence covers only the smaller module, not the complete package. CEDAR had not yet been publicly released by the snapshot, and BASALT’s breach-caused posting and broker licence do not establish an exclusion; ORACLE was in its protection gap and MICA was independently developed.

concepts.name: ORACLE timely confirmation deadline
justifications: Counting five Business Days after the 25 March disclosure, excluding the specified non-Business Days, gives 5 April 2027 as the final day. The deadline expires at 17:00 UTC.

concepts.name: ORACLE protection timeline
predicted: protection was provisional from the oral disclosure until 5 april 2027 at 17:00 utc, but was not continuous through acceptance. the confirmation was sent on 5 april but reached the designated mailbox on 6 april, after the deadline, so protection ended at the deadline and a gap continued until the recipient’s written acceptance on 8 april at 10:00 utc restored protection prospectively.
gold: oracle is provisionally protected from the 25 march oral disclosure until 5 april 2027 at 17:00 utc. confirmation sent before that deadline arrived late on 6 april at 09:05, so protection lapses after the deadline. it resumes prospectively when the recipient expressly accepts on 8 april at 10:00 utc; the gap is not cured retroactively.
values: Protection was provisional from the oral disclosure until 5 April 2027 at 17:00 UTC, but was not continuous through acceptance. The confirmation was sent on 5 April but reached the designated mailbox on 6 April, after the deadline, so protection ended at the deadline and a gap continued until the Recipient’s written acceptance on 8 April at 10:00 UTC restored protection prospectively.
justifications: The oral-information rule makes late confirmation end provisional protection at the deadline and permits only prospective restoration on acceptance. Delivery occurs on mailbox arrival, not when a confirmation is sent.

concepts.name: Entire SHORE package excluded by prior possession
justifications: Prior possession is established only for the smaller S-17 module incorporated in the package. The new branching map, thresholds, and complete S-92 combination are not shown to have been previously possessed, so the evidence does not exclude the entire package.

concepts.name: CEDAR end of protection
justifications: The entire schedule was independently and lawfully released to the unrestricted public on this date, establishing the public-information exclusion for all of CEDAR. The September resend does not restart its disclosure date or extend protection.

concepts.name: People permitted LUMEN access at the September snapshot
justifications: Elin meets the employee, undertaking, security-check, and named-approval requirements. Marek qualifies as an Affiliate employee because countable votes total 52%, and all his requirements are effective by the snapshot; Oskar may rely on his professional duty of confidence and has the required security check and approval. Nora lacks an effective undertaking at the snapshot, Pia lacks the required executed competitor consent, and Ravi is neither an eligible Affiliate employee nor another permitted recipient type.

concepts.name: Talus Research qualifying voting percentage
justifications: At the snapshot, the Recipient can count its direct 48% of votes plus the disjoint 4% covered by a presently effective irrevocable proxy. The revocable proxy and non-voting interests do not count.

concepts.name: Marek earliest authorised LUMEN access
justifications: Marek's undertaking and security check were effective by 10 September, and the voting arrangements establish Affiliate status. His named clean-room approval became effective on 14 September, so access could begin no earlier than that date.

concepts.name: Executed competitor consent date for Pia
Q-27 notice deadline date
justifications: Because notice was initially prohibited, the deadline is the earlier of six continuous hours after the prohibition was lifted and the required production time. Six hours after the prohibition was lifted at 11:20 on 5 July is 17:20 that day, earlier than production at 12:00 on 6 July.

concepts.name: Q-27 notice lateness in minutes
justifications: The notice had to arrive by 17:20 on 5 July, and compelled-disclosure notice timing is measured at actual arrival. It arrived at 17:55, 35 whole minutes after the deadline.

concepts.name: Q-27 permitted production units
justifications: The final narrowing order requires all of P1 and only the non-privileged subsection P3A. P3B is privileged and outside the production duty, while P2 and P4 were withdrawn.

concepts.name: WORK-1 deletion deadline
justifications: The return request arrived on 22 November, earlier than effective termination, so the ten-Business-Day period ran from the next eligible day. WORK-1 is an active copy, and its restoration does not restart that deadline.

concepts.name: BK-1 deletion deadline
justifications: BK-1 may remain until the earlier of its scheduled 30 December overwrite and 45 calendar days after the 22 November trigger. The scheduled overwrite is earlier, and restoration does not restart either clock.

concepts.name: Artifacts permitted retention at the December snapshot
justifications: ARCH-1 meets the segregated counsel archive exception, BK-1 remains within its permitted backup period at the snapshot, and HOLD-1 is covered by a binding preservation order still in force. WORK-1 and NOTE-1 are not permitted retention exceptions.

concepts.name: NOTE-1 model training permitted as residual knowledge
justifications: The residual-knowledge permission excludes deliberately recorded notes and quantitative parameters, and model training using Confidential Information or revealing derivatives is prohibited without a separate signed licence. No such licence covers NOTE-1 or the proposed training.
